items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: I had met Ham Davis, who's a trumpet player.

ctx.x: We were going to -- you were starting to talk about Charlie Johnson.

Charlie Johnson, yeah. So little things like that, picked up a couple of dollars, kept me eating. So I went down to Charlie Johnson's, and I had met Ham Davis, who's a trumpet player. I had met Charlie. Oh, drummer, uh, I'll recall his name in a minute. One of the greatest guys -- uh, I -- oh, what, what, what,what? Trying to think. Oh, Roane-- Kenneth Roane was the trumpet player in the band. He was a very fine man. When he -- I still say he's one of the greatest trumpet players that ever came to New York, ever…
